### Walkthrough The SageMaker async completion stream now reads its synchronous result iterator in a worker thread and stops on the `None` sentinel. A new test checks the yielded chunks and verifies that iterator reads occur off the event-loop thread. ### Changes **SageMaker async streaming** |Layer / File(s)|Summary| |:---|:---| |**Off-thread iterator reads**
`src/any_llm/providers/sagemaker/sagemaker.py`, `tests/unit/providers/test_sagemaker_provider.py`|`_acompletion` retrieves iterator results in a worker thread and stops when it receives `None`. The test checks the yielded chunks and confirms that iterator reads do not occur on the event-loop thread.| **Possibly related issues** - `mozilla-ai/any-llm` issue 1545 describes event-loop blocking during lazy Bedrock stream reads. This change applies an off-thread read pattern to SageMaker, but does not change Bedrock or implement the issue’s stream lifecycle requirements. Suggested reviewers: `peteski22` Change: Bug fix
